mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_banner (title, image_url, link_url, sort, status, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) VALUES (#{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkUrl}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stellar_banner WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort DESC, id ASC
